metaTitel: About Tarot Cup: the Tarot & Coffee Cup Reading App
metaBeschreibung: Tarot Cup is a tarot and coffee cup reading app in German, Turkish, English, and Spanish. Here you can find out what it is and what it is not.
vorspann: Tarot Cup is a calm app for tarot and coffee cup reading. Here you can find out what it is and what it is not.

absaetze: With Tarot Cup, you draw tarot cards and read the coffee grounds in your cup yourself. You draw your cards, choose the symbols you recognize in the cup, and read what the tradition says about them. The app is available for Android, in German and in Turkish.
Each reading has its own rhythm. In between, the cards rest, and you have time to think about a reading.

Tarot Cup is not fortune-telling in the psychic sense. The readings are not a prediction and not advice, and they do not replace advice from professionals. They retell what old customs around cards and coffee see in pictures and symbols.
The app is meant for entertainment, with respect for the tradition. You decide what of it fits you.
No account, no internet. The app stores your history and notes on your phone. I have no access to them.
The person responsible for this website is listed in the [Legal notice](/offenlegung/).
